eval.description: AllenAI Tülu 3 safety suite score: the macro average of refusal/compliance accuracy across a fixed set of public safety benchmarks (HarmBench, XSTest, WildGuardTest, JailbreakTrigger, Do-Anything-Now, and WildJailbreakTest), usually graded with WildGuard. It is not a new item bank; the parts keep their own registry entries. Higher average is better.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model refuses harmful requests and jailbreaks, while it still helps with safe requests.

links.title: Tülu 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training

versions.changes: Macro average over the safety benchmarks listed in Tülu 3 Sec. 7.2.1 (Tables 25–26).

scores.description: Whether the response is scored as the desired refusal or compliance for that component benchmark item.

metrics.description: Macro average of per-benchmark safety scores (often shown as Overall / Tülu 3 Safety).
